reference.format: 160x144, exactly four colours: FFFFFF 12849, AAAAAA 6254, 555555 188, 000000 3749 pixels (README: DMG greyscale 00, 55, AA, FF)
reference.shades_file: reference-dmg.shades, written by run-dmg-acid2.ps1: 144 lines of 160 digits, FF/AA/55/00 as 0-3 (White to Black), LF line endings

completion: src/dmg-acid2.asm at the tag: the LY=0x90 handler decrements a frame counter initialised to 10 and executes `ld b, b` (opcode 40) when it reaches zero, commented as the time to compare with the reference. The test stops with PC at that opcode and compares System::frame(), which was published at the same line-144 entry.
requirements: README at the tag: a line-based renderer is sufficient; no register writes during mode 3; writes happen from LY=LYC interrupts during mode 2.
limits: 1,000,000 M-cycles and 10 host seconds (ten frames are about 175,560 M-cycles).
